title.narrative: Multi-sectoral emergency assistance to displaced households victims of AD attacks in Beni territory

description.narrative: Since the weekend of August 13, 2016 over 50 people have been hacked to death with machetes and axes creating fear and displacement in the Beni City and surroundings. The killings have been blamed on the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF - Nalu) of Uganda - a group that have been linked to Islamic radicalists – and have forced large numbers of people to flee. The OCHA meeting of 19 August has reported displacement of over 2000 households toward towards Butembo, Bulongo and Alungupa/Mutwanga in the Sector of Rwenzori where they are living in precarious conditions in schools, churches, public places and other in host families. CAFOD has been granted fund from START Fund to quickly respond to this crisis. The project will be implemented by SOCOAC and will focus on serving 1,143 households (including 879 displaced households and 264 host families) in the rural communes of Bulongo and Alungupa in Rwenzori Sector (Beni territory) with food and NFI through the Fairs approach. Each beneficiary household (both displaced and host families) will receive vouchers worth $40 to purchase half ration in the fair as per cluster recommendation and vouchers worth $75 to purchase essential non-food items through NFI fairs (for a standard kit as recommended to SOCOAC by OCHA and RRMP during the meeting held on 25th August 2016). CAFOD and its partner SOCOAC have experience of running multiple food and NFI distribution fairs in the target area using this methodology.
